Short answer: we can reissue the invoice under reverse-charge provided the VAT ID validates. Monica in Billing, cc'd, will run the VIES check and confirm. If it validates we'll reissue NW-20260301 without VAT and add the required EU reverse-charge wording.

Couple of asks so we don't go back-and-forth:
- Can you confirm whether NorthWind will be the VAT-liable party (i.e., the VAT-registered business buying the service)?
- Confirm the billing address you want shown on the revised invoice (if different from the one we used).

I'll also flag AP that payment release is contingent on the corrected invoice; if we can turn this around today or tomorrow that should allow accounting to process the payment this week.
